# GEO report: trailhead **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 46/100, At risk Confidence: High (checked 23 of 23 points). How it's calculated: low = 10.5 ÷ 23 × 100 = 46. High = (10.5 + 0) ÷ 23 × 100 = 46. Nothing was left unknown, so the score is a single number. It's low because the site renders only in the browser and its one content page is marked noindex. The page metadata is also identical on every page, and the home page reaches the guides only through a button. All results are read from code. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Turn on server rendering - **Why it matters:** many crawlers read only the HTML the server first sends, and with `ssr: false` that HTML is an empty shell. - **Where:** `nuxt.config.ts:2` - **What the code says:** `ssr: false,` - **Size:** Medium - **Score after this:** 59 ### 2. Remove the noindex on `/guides` - **Why it matters:** `/guides` is in your sitemap and is your only content page. The middleware tells search engines to skip it, which sends mixed signals. It's also a Problem with 1 of 2 routes lost. - **Where:** `server/middleware/headers.ts:3` - **What the code says:** `setResponseHeader(event, 'X-Robots-Tag', 'noindex');` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 52 ### 3. Make `/guides` reachable through a real link - **Why it matters:** crawlers find pages by following `` links, and a button with a script handler isn't one. - **Where:** `pages/index.vue:8` - **What the code says:** `` - **Size:** Small (use ``) - **Score after this:** 54 ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Live | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid | Clear | Not run | `public/robots.txt`, valid lines, tiny file | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers allowed | Clear | Not run | `public/robots.txt:1-2` only blocks `/admin` (assumed you want to be found; no `geo.config.json`) | | GEO-014 | Linked routes are indexable | Problem | Not run | `/guides` noindex at `server/middleware/headers.ts:3`; `/` clear (1 of 2 routes) | | GEO-015 | Absolute canonical | Problem | Not run | No canonical in `app.vue:2` or `nuxt.config.ts` (0 of 2 routes) | | GEO-003 | Content in server HTML | Problem | Not run | `nuxt.config.ts:2` (site-wide) | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD valid | Not applicable | Not run | No JSON-LD in the project | | GEO-011 | Sitemap discoverable | Problem | Not run | `public/robots.txt:4` has a relative `Sitemap:` line | | GEO-012 | Title, description, lang | Problem | Not run | `app.vue:2` and `nuxt.config.ts:6` give every route the same title and description (0 of 2); `lang` is fine | | GEO-016 | Server-rendered links | Problem | Not run | `pages/index.vue:8` (`/guides` is a button only) | | GEO-017 | No snippet restrictions | Clear | Not run | No `nosnippet` or `max-snippet:0` in `server/middleware/headers.ts` or the pages | | GEO-002 | Accessibility basics | Clear | Not run | Read `app.vue` and `pages/index.vue`, `pages/guides.vue`; no images, and the button has text | | GEO-101 | App association files | Not applicable | Not run | No app declared | Informational, not scored: GEO-010 (no `llms.txt`, which is fine) and GEO-102 (not an app). ## Other problems found - **Sitemap and header disagree:** `public/sitemap.xml:4` has `https://trailhead.example/guides`, but `server/middleware/headers.ts:3` sets noindex on that path. Fix by removing the noindex (item 2). - **Placeholder domain:** `public/sitemap.xml:3` uses `https://trailhead.example/`. Make sure this is your real origin, and use the same one in canonicals and the `Sitemap:` line. ## Worth considering - **The guides page promises more than it shows:** `pages/guides.vue:4`: `

Routes graded from easy to strenuous.

`. No routes are listed. Listing them as text, ideally each with its own page and address, would give readers and machines something to quote. - **The home page says little:** `pages/index.vue:7`: `

Walks across the Peak District

`. Short text on who the site is for and what it covers might help people and tools understand it. - **Unreachable setting:** `nuxt.config.ts` has no site URL. Adding one (for example with a Nuxt site module) would make it easier to produce correct absolute canonicals and sitemap URLs. ## Can't tell from code - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs ` to check real crawlers against their published addresses. - **`/guides` noindex on a static host:** if the site is deployed as static files, the Nitro middleware may not run. A live check would show whether the header is really sent. ## Assumptions - You want search and AI search tools to find this site. - `/admin` is deliberately noindex and disallowed, so I didn't count it as a route or a problem. - I sampled `/` and `/guides` (the only public routes). ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
